question.text: Options contracts on a Valuation Day subsequent to purchase are priced using:

answer.text: Black-Scholes Model combined with MTM process

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.2.2, options subsequent to purchase are priced using Black-Scholes Model and MTM for fair market value. The Trap: Face value/book cost/intrinsic-only don't capture time value and volatility. Cross-Exam Context: Standard derivative valuation tested in VIII and IV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Black-Scholes assumes continuous trading and log-normal prices — apply liquidity overlays for illiquid underlyings.
